open_points.subject: HealthAnswer
open_points.text: `capability:deliverer_api.answer_health` returns the health answer with the OK member of = models.HealthStatus.
open_points.question: What is the exact structure of `HealthAnswer`, including the field that carries `HealthStatus.OK`?
options: An object with a `status` field whose value is `HealthStatus.OK`
An object using another field name

witness.initial: The service is listening and receives a health request.
events: The deployment calls the health route.
outcomes: The HTTP body is `"ok"` or an object whose field is not `status`.

open_points.subject: SOURCE_FORMATS and SOURCE_SIGNATURES
open_points.text: | `SOURCE_FORMATS` | `tuple[str, ...]` | `JPEG`, `PNG`, `WEBP`, the format names of the image library |
open_points.question: Does `SOURCE_FORMATS` contain exactly `JPEG`, `PNG` and `WEBP`, or all format names supported by the image library in addition to those three; and, if it contains more, where are their required signature rows defined?
options: Exactly `JPEG`, `PNG` and `WEBP`; the trailing words describe those values
Every format name supported by the image library, requiring additional `SOURCE_SIGNATURES` rows
The three named formats plus some separately selected library formats
open_points.default_guess: Treat the tuple as exactly `("JPEG", "PNG", "WEBP")`, matching the complete signature table.

witness.initial: The photo folder contains a valid image in an image-library-supported format other than JPEG, PNG or WEBP.
events: The calling flow requests a scan.
outcomes: An implementation reading the constant as exactly three formats reports `REJECTED` with `UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT`.
An implementation reading it as all image-library format names treats the format as admitted but must invent or obtain an unstated signature rule, potentially reporting `READY`.
witness.observer: The calling flow receiving the scan result
